faq_free_access_window.s:
The PDF's Timeline & Fees is NEW info not in the FAQ: August 1-10, 2026 = 10 days of FREE portal access for all participants; August 11, 2026 = free access ends, continued participation requires the N15,000 registration fee; September 19, 2026 = registration officially closes. The FAQ is the single source of truth for registration facts, so encode the free window there. (N15,000 already matches REG_AMOUNT=15000 in constants.ts; the September 19 close is already stated - only the free window is missing.)

PHASE 1 - failing probe: `rg -n "free for everyone|August 11" src/lib/data/faq.ts` returns nothing. PHASE 2 = confirm. PHASE 3 - edit src/lib/data/faq.ts verbatim:

A. Line 28 (deadline answer) - old: `{ q: 'Is there a registration deadline?', a: 'Registration closes September 19, 2026. Participants may join the championship at any time during the period of Online Training. The earlier you register, the more time your child has to learn and improve.' },` - new: `{ q: 'Is there a registration deadline?', a: 'Registration closes September 19, 2026. Portal access is free for everyone from August 1 to August 10; from August 11, continued participation requires the N15,000 registration fee. Participants may join the championship at any time between August 1 and September 19. The earlier you register, the more time your child has to learn and improve.' },` (use the naira symbol U+20A6.. no - use the actual Naira sign 'N' with double underline U+20A6 is wrong; the site writes it as the Naira sign character. In the file the symbol is the standard Naira sign 'Naira sign' (U+20A6). Match the exact glyph the file already uses for N15,000 elsewhere, e.g. faq.ts:29 uses the same symbol. Keep byte-identical Naira symbol.)

B. Line 29 (fee answer) - old: `{ q: 'Is there a registration fee?', a: \`Yes. The registration fee is N${REG_AMOUNT.toLocaleString()}. Participants with a partner code pay N${discounted_amount.toLocaleString()}.\` },` - new: `{ q: 'Is there a registration fee?', a: \`Yes. The registration fee is N${REG_AMOUNT.toLocaleString()}, required from August 11 after 10 days of free portal access (August 1-10). Participants with a partner code pay N${discounted_amount.toLocaleString()}.\` },` (en dash in "August 1-10"; keep the Naira symbol glyph identical).

PHASE 4 - `rg -n "free for everyone|August 11" src/lib/data/faq.ts` now hits; `pnpm test` + `pnpm check` green (no test asserts FAQ strings - verified).
